findings.description: render() is called outside the try block. campaign.body_template.format(first_name=...) can raise KeyError, IndexError or ValueError if the template contains other braces or placeholders. The exception propagates out of send_campaign, so the loop stops partway and the caller never receives the CampaignReport. Subscribers already emailed are lost from the report, and a retry would send to them again.
findings.suggestion: Move render() inside the try block and handle or record render errors per subscriber. Alternatively, validate the template before the loop.
findings.title: Render failure aborts the whole campaign mid-send
